DIAGNOSIS READY: Right Hip Dislocation (Posterior).

The clinical presentation of a shortened, flexed, adducted, and internally rotated leg following a high-energy rear-end collision is classic for a posterior hip dislocation, which requires immediate reduction to prevent avascular necrosis of the femoral head.
